Hi Sophie —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for sharing details about Orion Health's ingestion volumes and regulatory constraints. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get the right folks on the call: 

Quick recap from today's discovery:
- Primary use case: near-real-time triage and summarization of clinician notes (avg doc length ~600 tokens).
- Data constraints: PHI in scope; need KMS + audit logs and SOC 2 evidence.
- Success metrics: <=200ms 95th percentile latency for generation path, predictable cost per 1M tokens.

Proposed next meeting: platform walkthrough + runbook review (we'll cover model variants, private deployment options, and security controls). Two slots that work on our side: 
- Wed, Sep 23 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu, Sep 24 — 1:00–2:00 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works (or propose alternatives) and please list the attendees you want present (technical lead, security, procurement, etc.)? Also tell us if you prefer Zoom or Google Meet — either is fine.

I've attached a short one-pager that outlines what we'll cover so your team can see the agenda.

Attachments: [attachment: Redwood_runbook_onepager.pdf]

Next steps if Wed 9/23 works: Monica (cc'd) will send an invite with a calendar attachment + Meet/Zoom link and we'll include a lightweight pre-read.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning the right folks.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
